steps: Set the grill to 300°F and bank the coals to the back for a two-zone setup.
Install a half-moon deflector shield on one side to create the indirect zone.
Season the wings all over with the sweet lemon pepper rub and granulated honey.
Place wings on the direct side and cook to render for 15 minutes, dome closed.
Check browning; rotate wings that need more color to the hottest spot and cook another 15 minutes.
Flip the wings (keeping them on the direct side) and cook 10 more minutes, dome closed.
Move the wings to the indirect side and cook until the internal temp reaches 175°F.
For crispier skin, char briefly on the direct side with the dome open for 30–60 seconds, then serve.
